name: Steel & Metals Cross-Sectional Momentum
description: Cross-sectional momentum strategy on 9 steel and metals stocks (X, NUE, STLD, CLF, AA, ATI, CENX, FCX, SCCO). Signal: 5-month return skipping the most recent month (T-126 to T-21, classic skip-month momentum). Portfolio: Long top 3 stocks by momentum, equal weight (1/3 each), monthly rebalance on first trading day. Long only — no short leg.
source:
# Steel & Metals Cross-Sectional Momentum
# Classic skip-month momentum on steel and metals stocks
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 10 steel/metals stocks (X, NUE, STLD, CLF, AA, ATI, CENX, CMC, FCX, SCCO)
# - Signal: 5-month return skipping the most recent month (T-126 to T-21)
# - Selection: Top 3 stocks by momentum
# - Weighting: Equal weight (1/3 each)
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)
# - Direction: Long only — no short leg

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Skip-month momentum: return from T-126 to T-21
# Skips the most recent 21 trading days (~1 month) to avoid short-term reversal
# Measures the return over the prior 5 months ending 1 month ago
skip_month_momentum = (close >> 21) / (close >> 126) - 1

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 by momentum
# cs_select returns boolean mask: True for top 3 sectors
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(skip_month_momentum)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals
# Enter when sector enters top 3 at month start, exit when it leaves
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_3

# Hold position until next month rebalance
held_signal = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_signal)

# Equal weight across selected sectors
weights = equal_weight()(held_signal)

# Position sizing - ONLY rebalance on first trading day of month
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
